about: Checksums that tie the committed evidence of study 3's scored run study3-scored-1 to the raw run folder and its archive kept outside the repository, and its analysis and legacy-load outputs to the runs that wrote them. bundleChecksum is the runner's checksum over the bundle's file list (study/harness/runner.py, write_bundle); bundleJsonSha256, the archive, sums-file and evidence-file digests are SHA-256 of the exact bytes as the run, the archive and the scripts wrote them (LF). scores.csv and manifest.json are byte copies of the run folder's files, from a copy verified against the per-file sums file on 2026-11-25. results.json, tables.md and figures/effort.svg are the output of study/analysis3/analyze3.py at commit 72d39c2b3153de19c54f8994d397070d00f19063 under the frozen PLAN.md, run twice on 2026-11-26 with byte-identical outputs. legacy-load.json and legacy-load.md are the output of study/analysis3/legacy3.py at the same commit, run twice on 2026-11-26 with byte-identical outputs, on the same copy and a checked copy of the run's legacy-load folder. The archive zip holds the results folder of the scored run, its rehearsal, the two carried preflight runs, the harness's MCP call logs and the three per-file sums files; the setup zip holds the run's configuration, logs and state, the legacy-load folder included, and SHA256SUMS-setup; the unlisted sums file gives the sums of the 178 archived files that no per-file sums file lists.
